name: Cycling
instructions: Adjust the saddle so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Sit tall with your hands relaxed on the handlebars.
Pedal at a steady cadence of about 70 to 90 rpm at a conversational effort.
Increase resistance or speed gradually for intervals or longer rides.
Cool down for several minutes at an easy pace.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: Steady cycling on a stationary or road bike for low-impact cardiovascular fitness.

safetyNotes: Warm up before pushing hard; stop and seek advice for chest pain or dizziness.
